snippet.title: Broken Shell - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Broken Shell is a short, hand-drawn puzzle adventure about two hermit crabs searching for a place to call home. Explore a vibrant underwater world, solve gentle puzzles, and experience a heartfelt story told entirely without words. Broken Shell will be available on PC.
